constraints: Do not substitute a different UUID found by email if exact_identity_rows is not 1.
Only the guarded DELETE FROM auth_user is a mutation; account removal must use the verified ON DELETE CASCADE.
No manual deletion from auth_account, auth_session, auth_verification, business tables, rate-limit tables, or configuration.
Preflight checks do not replace the same guards evaluated atomically inside DELETE.

preflight.sql:
WITH candidate AS (SELECT u.id,u.email,u.email_verified,u.name
FROM auth_user AS u
WHERE u.id = ?1 COLLATE BINARY
  AND u.email = ?3 COLLATE BINARY
  AND length(?2) = 40
  AND ?2 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  AND ?3 = ('delivered+safeplaces-auth-' || substr(?2,1,12) || '@resend.dev') COLLATE BINARY)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate) AS exact_identity_rows,
 COALESCE((SELECT email_verified = 0 AND name = 'Safe Places auth mail check' FROM candidate),0) AS simulator_profile_matches,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_session s JOIN candidate c ON s.user_id = c.id) AS session_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account a JOIN candidate c ON a.user_id = c.id) AS account_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account a JOIN candidate c ON a.user_id = c.id
   WHERE a.provider_id = 'credential' AND a.account_id = c.id
     AND a.password IS NOT NULL
     AND a.access_token IS NULL AND a.refresh_token IS NULL AND a.id_token IS NULL) AS credential_only_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_verification v JOIN candidate c
   ON v.value = c.id OR v.identifier = c.id OR v.identifier = c.email COLLATE BINARY) AS verification_reference_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM customer_wishlists WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM activity WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM files WHERE owner_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM request_events WHERE actor_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM request_drafts WHERE updated_by IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM admin_members WHERE auth_user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id) OR invited_by IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id) OR email = c.email COLLATE BINARY)) AS has_other_references;

delete.sql:
WITH candidate AS (SELECT u.id,u.email,u.email_verified,u.name
FROM auth_user AS u
WHERE u.id = ?1 COLLATE BINARY
  AND u.email = ?3 COLLATE BINARY
  AND length(?2) = 40
  AND ?2 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  AND ?3 = ('delivered+safeplaces-auth-' || substr(?2,1,12) || '@resend.dev') COLLATE BINARY)
DELETE FROM auth_user
WHERE id IN (
 SELECT c.id FROM candidate c
 WHERE c.email_verified = 0 AND c.name = 'Safe Places auth mail check'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_session s WHERE s.user_id = c.id)
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account a WHERE a.user_id = c.id) = 1
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account a
       WHERE a.user_id = c.id AND a.provider_id = 'credential' AND a.account_id = c.id
         AND a.password IS NOT NULL
         AND a.access_token IS NULL AND a.refresh_token IS NULL AND a.id_token IS NULL) = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_verification v
       WHERE v.value = c.id OR v.identifier = c.id OR v.identifier = c.email COLLATE BINARY)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM customer_wishlists WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM activity WHERE user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM files WHERE owner_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM request_events WHERE actor_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM request_drafts WHERE updated_by IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM admin_members WHERE auth_user_id IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id) OR invited_by IN (c.id, 'customer:' || c.id) OR email = c.email COLLATE BINARY)
)
RETURNING id;

postcondition.sql:
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_user WHERE id = ?1 COLLATE BINARY) AS user_id_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_user WHERE email = ?3 COLLATE BINARY) AS alias_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_account WHERE user_id = ?1 COLLATE BINARY) AS account_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = ?1 COLLATE BINARY) AS session_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_verification WHERE value = ?1 COLLATE BINARY OR identifier = ?1 COLLATE BINARY OR identifier = ?3 COLLATE BINARY) AS verification_reference_rows;
